description: Chat spams 'ventilasi' while Windah hunts for the hidden money; he then claims he found it alone, 'tanpa bantuan viewer, nemu. Ventilasi itu, cuy.' Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-ventilasi/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-ventilasi.mp4): four pieces (0.6 s padding each) of windah-live9/stream-1959-2059.mp4 (h1, file t 0 = 19:59 WIB) in output order, 1080p30 re-encoded and joined. Cuts: A t 2651.00-2653.00 = local 0.60-2.60 -> output 0.00-2.00; B t 2666.70-2670.55 = local 3.80-7.65 -> output 2.00-5.85; C t 2673.00-2680.80 = local 8.85-16.65 -> output 5.85-13.65; D t 2681.20-2682.90 = local 17.85-19.55 -> output 13.65-15.35. Beats in stream order: Windah leaves the apartment yard with 3000 dollars ('cabut nih gua', h1 44:11); 'the money the detective meant, that was the 3000' (44:26); then, after the missed-it swear, the claim 'gue sendiri, tanpa bantuan viewer, nemu. Ventilasi itu, cuy' (44:33-44:40) and 'nice nice nice' (44:41). Chat had spammed 'ventilasi' for minutes before (chat spike #1 43:13) and roasts the claim right after (#6 44:46); no chat is audible or on screen, the label and hook carry it. Word timings from medium faster-whisper, no VAD ('tiduran' before 'gue sendiri' at 44:34.7 is a doubtful word and is not subtitled: check by ear). CUT: 'gak nemu, anjir, goblok banget' (44:30.8-44:32.4) and the two 'anjir' right after it (cut C starts at 44:33.0); 44:19-44:27 'kita gak perlu takedown dua polisi itu' (violence mention); the in-game vehicle name pop-up (lower left, 44:26-44:30) is blurred and a building sign with a company name at the top of the frame (44:39+) is blurred. No viewer names on screen, no guns or gore, no brand text spoken. The car is a plain pink sports car, no badge readable. Main 15.35 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Facecam-below layout (windah_recipe.py layout 'face'): gameplay = source crop 1504x846 at (0,0) scaled to 1080x608 at y364 (the corner facecam is outside the crop, no blur), Windah's facecam = source crop 352x264 at (1568,516) scaled to 520x390 in a 4 px Volt frame, centred at x276, y994-1392, clear of TikTok's bottom caption area and right icon column; hook line 1 Paper 'TANPA BANTUAN VIEWER', line 2 Volt 'KATA WINDAH', Audex 68, bottom-anchored at y318; credit tag y326; subs at y905 over the lower gameplay panel. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
